contact_sources.quote:
Rajiv Jain - Chairman, CIO & Portfolio Manager at GQG ...
Description: Rajiv is the Chairman and Chief Investment Officer of GQG Partners and also serves as the portfolio manager for all GQG Partners strategies. He founded GQG Partners in June 2016 with over 23 years of investment experience, most notably as the Co-Chief Executive Officer (from July 2014) and Chief Investment Officer and Head of Equities (from February 2002) at Vontobel Asset Management. He was a Morningstar Fund Manager of the Year in 2012. The information on this page is for viewing [...] ## Experience
- Chairman, CIO & Portfolio Manager at GQG Partners (Jun 2016 to present)
- Former CIO , Co-CEO & Portfolio Manager at Vontobel Asset Management (Mar 2014 to May 2016)
- CIO & Portfolio Manager at Vontobel Asset Management (Jan 2002 to May 2016)
- Portfolio Manager at Vontobel Asset Management (Oct 1994 to May 2016)

quality.reason: Es un nombre de persona y una firma de inversión real.
